metadata.title: EA-CTL-SYSML-001 Enterprise SysML projection control (candidate)
metadata.remarks: Candidate representation only; no OSCAL schema certification or governance approval implied.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Maintain traceable SysML v2 projections for in-scope enterprise applications, services and managed engines, linked to live registered identities and ArchiMate architecture; require verified parser output, controlled approval attestations and formal waivers for a release pass.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: A baseline inventory pass is not SysML v2 conformance. Proprietary SaaS systems may have black-box boundary/interface projections. Production deployment controls must be separately enforced. No approval is inferred from repository publication.
